newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki recovers to close flat after late spurt.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki recovers to close flat after late spurt.

text.p: Shares closed a mixed session flat on Tuesday, recovering on a late spurt of buying as foreign investors got into the market, brokers said.

The FOX stock futures index ended up 0.19 percent at 1,073.61, while the all-share HEX closed down 0.05 percent at 3,109.54 points. Decliners beat advancers 45 to 39. Volume was at summertime levels, amounting to just 433 million markka.
"This has been fairly neutral," one broker said, "the weather is beautiful, so there's already a bit of summer stagnation."
But a higher opening by Wall Street stocks boosted confidence in late trade. "If the U.S. market holds up, we could rise quite nicely tomorrow," one broker said.
Nokia closed down 2.00 markka at 352.00, but struggled back from an intraday low of 350.00 in fair 100 million markka volume.
Huhtamaki added 2.00 markka to end at 225.00 after reporting January-April profits broadly in line with analysts' forecasts. Volume in the share was a modest 1.4 million markka.
But some brokers said they wanted to see better results. "It is an enternal promise, the whole company," one said.
